decisions.reason: The candidate already records the same-message rendering color reference; adding light around the power button does not change the enclosure color rules.
The candidate already records the deck labels and rendering fidelity from this message, while the power-button lighting is independently owned by the LED lighting Requirement.
The existing same-message Event captures the back-panel design and font instruction; power-button accent lighting does not alter the placard text or placement.
The existing same-message Event captures the instruction to recreate the bottom logo; the added power-button light has no further effect on the base logo treatment.
The source does not explicitly change the cursive K marking, its placement, or its color; the generic reference to buttons does not necessarily supersede the current branding.
Lighting around the power button changes its accent treatment but not the dedicated master-control behavior or placement.
Power-button accent lighting does not change bowl capacity, depth, form, or enclosure-size constraints.
Although LEDs are physical components, the source does not necessarily reopen the approved BOM or require a revised BOM deliverable.
The source concerns visual lighting around the master power button and does not change dispense-button actuation or solenoid valve behavior.
The lighting decision does not affect mixing smoothness, foam quality, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The newly required power-button accent light is an additional electrical load that the system power capacity must support.
